selection_objective: Equal protocol/duration cells; mean queries within specimen, then equal specimen mean, then equal cell mean
primary_selection_history: single protocol, 0.5 logged-second support; diagnostic only
selection_domains: Original domains for historical extensions; common known-speed domain for the prospective matched familiar/omitted experiment
claim_limit: Finite computational policy, not verified asymptotic convergence. Four of six bounded trajectories still hit 120. No further cap chase, no architecture/QC/feature change, no choice based on transfer advantage. Existing historical CLI configurations remain unchanged at 60 epochs; the next matched configs must explicitly adopt this policy. Not a scientific freeze or locked-test interface.
